work.title: Preserve legacy projection compatibility
work.description: Keep existing repositories readable when manifests already exist on manifest refs, archive refs, the base branch, and older Change branches. The compatibility layer prefers the authoritative manifest ref and uses older locations only as recovery fallbacks.
acceptance: Repositories created before INIT-6 remain readable
A manifest ref always wins over a base projection
Legacy base-only Works can be discovered
Legacy Works can be migrated without rewriting accepted integration commits
Compatibility fallback usage is visible through inspection or doctor output
New Works never depend on the legacy fallback
